summary: XCF Global, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 8, 2026, reporting entry into a $1,000,000 senior secured loan with Brown Stone Capital Limited, featuring a 25% original issue discount (purchase price $750,000), 10% annual interest, and a two-month term. The loan is secured by a first-priority lien on inventories, accounts, and other assets, but excludes subsidiaries. A commitment fee of 500,000 shares of Class A common stock was issued, with 5,000,000 reserved as penalty default shares. This financing is a routine debt agreement, not a special situation.
